photos.llama_desc: A woman in a black and white cat-themed onesie is sitting on a bed, holding a phone and smiling at the camera. She is surrounded by a laptop, a phone charger, and a small bag of pink candies. The room is decorated with a white bedspread and a brown and gold striped bed … .

A young girl in a red sweatshirt... 
She is holding a laptop computer and smiling at the camera. Her long blonde hair is falling across her face. She is sitting on a couch or chair in a living room with a Christmas tree in the background.

A table with a white tablecloth and a banner that reads "Weih's Family Reunion" in a gothic font. The banner is placed on a table in front of a window with white curtains, and there are several books and a plate on the table.
A historic building in downtown Indianapolis. The building is a large, white, stone structure with a dome on top. It has many windows and a large, central entrance.

A Lincoln Memorial in Washington D.C. is reflected in a calm and still body of water. The memorial's white marble and columns are reflected in the water's surface, creating a sense of symmetry and harmony.

A man in a white shirt... 
He stands in the shallow water of a lake, looking out at the water. He is wearing a white shirt and dark pants. The lake is calm and clear, with a few rocks and a small boat in the distance.

A man in a red shirt... 
He is sitting at a table with a woman in a blue and white patterned blouse and a young man in a blue and white plaid shirt. They are all smiling and looking at the camera. The man in the red shirt is holding a fork and has a plate of food in front of him.
A person on a beach at sunset. The person is standing alone on the beach, looking out at the horizon. The sky is a deep orange and pink, with the sun just below the horizon.

A digital display of a swimming event's results. The screen shows a list of names and times for the girls' 200-meter individual medley event, with the top name and time being "Blake, Chloe" with a time of 2:29.5. The event is listed as "Girls 200 IM" and the location is "SOUTH".

This photo features a young woman in a white graduation gown, cap, and multiple colorful cords around her neck. She is smiling and looking directly at the camera. The woman's long, light-brown hair is falling over her shoulders, and she is wearing a white graduation cap with a tassel.

A woman in a yellow t-shirt... 
She stands in front of a yellow school bus with a white roof, wearing a yellow t-shirt with a blue logo on it, and a pair of blue shorts. She has her right hand on her hip and her left hand on her hip, with her left foot slightly in front of her right. The bus has a large banner on the side that reads "Congratulations Class of 2020".

She is lying on her side, her head and shoulders hidden under a white duvet. Her hair is a mess of brown and red, and her face is partially hidden by the bedding. She is surrounded by a white bed, with a few pillows and a white sheet.

A group of people in front of a castle. They are standing on a paved road, with a large, multi-towered castle in the background. The castle has a central, high, pointed tower and several lower, more rounded towers.

A woman in a graduation cap... 
She is smiling and wearing a white graduation cap. She has long, wavy blonde hair and is wearing a yellow or orange gown. She is standing in front of a white building with a window behind her.

A woman in a white graduation gown... 
She is wearing a white graduation cap and a long, white, buttoned-up gown. She is smiling and holding a diploma.

A woman in a purple and pink scarf... She is standing with her arms around a young girl, both of them smiling at the camera. The woman is wearing a purple and pink scarf around her neck, and the girl is wearing a black and white striped shirt. They are standing in front of a dark background, with no other people or objects in the scene.

A statue of a man on horseback in a park. The statue is on a large stone pedestal, with a smaller statue of a woman at its base. The statue of the man is in a military uniform, with a horse that is also in a military style.

A group of three children in soccer jerseys... 
They stand with their arms crossed, looking serious, with their eyes fixed on something in the distance. The boy in the red and black striped jersey has his arms crossed, while the girl in the orange jersey has her arms folded, and the girl in the blue jersey has her arms crossed, all of them looking very serious. They are standing on a lush green grassy field.
A plate of breakfast food on a wooden table. A plate of scrambled eggs, bacon, and a biscuit sits on a wooden table. The eggs are yellow and white, and the bacon is crispy and brown.

A family of six standing together. The woman in the white graduation cap and gown is surrounded by her family, who are all smiling and looking at her with pride. The woman is wearing a white graduation cap and gown, with a gold and blue graduation cord around her neck.

A group of women in swim team uniforms standing on a podium. They are all wearing medals around their necks and are standing on a series of numbered steps, with a man in a blue shirt and a woman in a green hat standing at the far end of the podium. The women are standing on a poolside area with a pool in the background.
A young girl in a blue and white holiday sweater... She is standing in front of a brick fireplace, holding a pink plastic egg. She has long blonde hair and is smiling at the camera.

A dog in a car... 
A brown dog is sitting in the driver's seat of a car, its head and front paws visible through the open window. The dog's fur is matted and its eyes are focused on something outside the car. The car is parked on a grassy street with a few trees and a sidewalk in the background.

A young woman in a gray hoodie... 
She is sitting on a brown couch, holding a small blue gift box in her right hand and a colorful candy box in her left. Her long brown hair is loose and her nails are painted a light blue color.

A man in a white shirt... 
He is embracing a woman with his right arm around her shoulders. Her left hand is on his right shoulder. They are both smiling.

A family of seven people in a living room. They are standing in front of a Christmas tree, with a table to the right of the photo. The woman in the center is wearing a black and white striped sweater, and the man to her right is wearing a red shirt.

A row of cars in a parking lot. The cars are parked in a row, with their front ends facing the camera, and are reflected in the shiny surface of a nearby lake or waterway. The cars are parked in a parking lot, with a mountainous landscape in the background.
A man in a grey shirt... is shaking hands with a man in a red jacket. He is wearing a yellow wristband on his left hand. The man in the red jacket is holding a microphone.

A woman in a black and white cat-themed onesie is lying on a bed, holding a laptop and a bag of snacks. She is smiling and looking directly at the camera. The bed is covered with a white comforter and has a few pillows and a laptop charger on it.

A menu board for Pine State Biscuits, a restaurant in Portland, Oregon, featuring a list of biscuit sandwiches, including "The Reggie", "The Reggie Deluxe", and "The Veggie Reggie". The menu board is white with a black border and a logo for Pine State Biscuits at the top. The menu items are listed in a clear, easy-to-read font, with prices and descriptions of each sandwich.
